description: Evidence-tracking matrix for named iPhone variants. Apple lists iPhone 14 through 18 Pro models and iPhone 17e as compatible with iOS 27; rows track model and OS family, not every point release/build. No row implies jailbreak compatibility. Reported iPhone 18 Pro demo remains experimental only.

rows.notes: Device family/variant and identifier are based on Apple's model-identification reference where listed; exact supported OS/build combinations and jailbreak evidence remain to be researched. Confirm identifier and OS availability against primary technical sources before making compatibility claims.
